items.title: Crocodile sighted in Kukkarahalli Lake
items.snippet_en: A "huge crocodile" was spotted near the fishermen's shed in Kukkarahalli Lake between 8:30 AM and 9:30 AM on December 1, 2024, and photographed by K.U. Varghese.

items.title: Crocodile spotted at Kukkarahalli Lake
items.snippet_en: A report from January 28, 2026, mentions a crocodile being spotted recently at the bank of Kukkarahalli Lake, with environmental lover Vikas Gowda stating he saw it four times.

items.title: Kukkarahalli Lake crocodile threat raises safety concerns
items.snippet_en: In September 2026, visitors were warned about crocodile attacks at Kukkarahalli Lake, indicating their continued presence.
A Facebook post mentions a report of a crocodile being spotted during an evening walk at Kukkarahalli Lake.

outputs.notes_en: None of the provided sources confirm a sighting of two crocodiles on October 8, 2026, in Kukkarahalli Lake. However, all sources indicate that crocodile sightings are common in this lake, providing context for the claim.
